attr.title: Pocket Vectors
attr.desc: Retro flight sim with modern data: a full HUD over real terrain, real airports, flight plans and real instrument approaches. Fly aircraft from the Cessna 172 to the Boeing 747 on the JSBSim flight model.
attr.inst: Copy FlightSim.sh and the flightsim folder to your ports folder. Build a data pack on a PC (see the project docs) and put it in flightsim/data. Exit with Select + Start.
